title: X0 Bot: eight minimal concepts
subtitle: Concepts first, finish later. Each is one silhouette plus two eyes with attitude (and at most one signature detail) on a loud colour field, kept flat on purpose. Ranked, strongest first. Pick a direction and it gets the full render. The dashed card is the Grok Bot icon, for comparison only.

4-half-peek.title: Half-peek
4-half-peek.line: Only the top of the box head clears the bottom edge; the eyes slide sideways. Maximum tension, pure Peek, readable at 29 px. Owns the idea.

8-corner-eye.title: One eye round the corner
8-corner-eye.line: A huge head slides in from the edge and only one eye has made it round. One shape, one mark, total curiosity. The boldest, but less obviously a bot.

1-kilroy.title: Kilroy peek
1-kilroy.line: Head, fingers and wall as ONE black shape; sly slits of yellow for eyes. Understood instantly, but Kilroy is a 1940s doodle everyone already owns.

3-visor.title: The visor alone
3-visor.line: One black glass band tilted across acid lime, two determined eyes. Loud and graphic, but it reads as a masked bandit, not a friendly helper.

7-two-tone.title: Two-tone
7-two-tone.line: A black box head off the bottom left, one eye narrower: mischief. Strong, but the closest in spirit to Grok Bot.

6-bolt-antenna.title: Bolt antenna
6-bolt-antenna.line: A plain head whose one signature is a lightning-zag antenna, eyes rolled up at it. Fun, but the bolt says 'electric', not 'helper'.

5-x0-attitude.title: X0 attitude
5-x0-attitude.line: The name in the face: one eye squeezed into an X, the other a 0. Clever, but an X eye still whispers 'knocked out'.

2-sly-square.title: Sly square
2-sly-square.line: A huge white box head with narrowed eyes. Reads 'unimpressed', not powerful. Dropped.

reference.title: Grok Bot (reference)
reference.line: Not ours: one shape, two marks, attitude, cropped. The lesson, not the look.
